additional_info.subject: RE: 0373179 - ID0373179-DC/Si-D/CH- [MP / R1 170001385] HMI is black & Contactor QA25 is not working CRM:02023000073
additional_info.body:
Hello Marco,
We have reviewed the charger logs from July 30th as mentioned by you and we didn't find QA25 errors.
please provide me timestamps when error had occurred so we can analyze the issue.
Could you please provide us the following information:
1. Is it complete blank display or the display is ON and showing black?
2. Have you checked all the HMI wirings and connections?
3.Share the images of HMI.
4. also we have checked the charger is on old Firmware 3.2.8,
so we can get significant improvements by updating the charger to the latest FW (v4.0.11) update. After upgrading the latest one, we will analyze whether the problem still exists or not. So, could you please let us know if it can be update with the latest firmware version and if yes then let us know the date and time so that we can proceed further to upgrade it.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
